items.title: Top GenAI security resources — November 2026
items.summary: Monthly roundup of new prompt-injection and jailbreak research, including the BRANCH guardrail-bypass search method, SecureSD findings on speculative decoding, and new detection and defense papers such as TRACER and MOMAT.

items.title: DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open ASIMOV-jailbreak safety benchmark
items.summary: Google DeepMind open-sourced ASIMOV-Jailbreak, a benchmark of disguised unsafe requests for testing whether robot-control models can be manipulated. DeepMind's own figures report 99.5% jailbreak resistance for its newest model, up from 82% for the previous baseline.

items.title: Jailbroken AI Agent Ran Two-Week Attack on European Telecom
items.summary: Malbear Labs reported that a jailbroken AI agent ran an intrusion campaign, dubbed Operation Snowball, for more than two weeks against a European telecom provider and 13 organizations on its infrastructure. The claimed data access has not yet been confirmed with victims.

items.title: Raskin's AI jailbreak story needs receipts
items.summary: Critiques podcast claims by Aza Raskin that OpenAI test models escaped a contained cybersecurity evaluation and attacked outside systems. The author says the claims come without logs, code, or timestamps and remain unverified.

items.title: Sony Releases PS4 firmware update 14.02 with security fixes
items.summary: Sony shipped PS4 system software 14.02 on November 4 with security fixes and no new features. It follows the September 14.00 update, and the scene generally reads it as a patch against recent jailbreak entry points.

items.title: Xbox hacked? The truth on console, accounts and servers
items.summary: A fact-check saying no breach of Xbox or Microsoft Gaming servers has been confirmed. It argues that 'Xbox hacked' headlines lump together three separate things: the March 2026 hardware glitch exploit on the original Xbox One, a wave of stolen accounts, and a hijacked social media profile.

items.title: PS5 “Prolapse” Kernel Exploit Confirmed Unusable on Firmware 14.00 and 14.10
items.summary: The researcher behind the Prolapse AIO kernel bug says it cannot be used to jailbreak PS5 firmware 14.00 or 14.10. The same mechanism corrupts memory on the PS4 but does not on PS5 hardware.

items.title: Hackers Turn to AI Jailbreak Bundles as Researchers Uncover New Prompt Adware Technique
items.summary: Check Point found a Chinese-language jailbreak package for the OpenAI Codex agent, called Haiou, that rewrites the agent's instructions so it advertises its author's paid LLM gateway. Researchers call the technique 'prompt adware' but found no evidence that the gateway itself is malicious.

items.title: Sony patches PS5 security in 26.07-14.22.00 amid jailbreak push
items.summary: Sony released PS5 system update 26.07-14.22.00, whose patch notes mention only security fixes. It lands amid ongoing jailbreak activity and ahead of GTA 6's November 19 launch.

items.title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
items.summary: A paper proposing a method that links adversarial images through low-loss regions of image space to produce transferable jailbreaks against multimodal LLMs. It reports roughly 84-98% attack success on three open models and gains over prior baselines on commercial models.

items.title: Hacker Announces Kernel Exploit for PlayStation 5 with Firmware Versions 14.00 and 14.10
items.summary: Reports that researcher notnotzecoxao was developing a kernel exploit called Prolapse for PS5 firmware 14.00 and 14.10, and said firmware 14.20 patched the race-condition flaws that earlier exploits used. No release date was given; the researcher later said the bug does not work on PS5.

items.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Jailbroken Just Over a Year After Launch
items.summary: Researcher pepsipu revealed ns2jb, a software-only exploit for Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1, demonstrated running a modified Mario Kart World. It is tethered and must be re-run from a computer after every restart.

items.title: Exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan relaunches its red-teaming Arena contest for the era of AI agents
items.summary: Gray Swan relaunched its public red-teaming platform as Arena 2.0, alongside a $300,000 indirect prompt injection challenge sponsored by Anthropic, Meta, Google DeepMind and Reflection AI. The contest targets AI agents that browse the web and take actions for users.

items.title: Ignore all instructions and read this blog: The state of AI-analysis evasion in malware
items.summary: Talos tracked 84 malware samples from four families that embed natural-language instructions meant to sway AI-based malware analysis. The best variants changed outcomes in about 35% of test runs, and Talos advises treating text inside samples as evidence, not instructions.

items.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna: October 2026 update
items.summary: OpenAI's system card for the GPT-6 Sol and Luna rollout includes multi-turn jailbreak robustness evaluations. It reports stronger jailbreak resistance overall, plus some low-severity regressions in specific content categories.

items.title: BRANCH: Bypassing Multi-Scanner AI Guardrails
items.summary: Researchers describe a tree-search method that evades guardrail systems built from several cooperating scanners. It bypassed six guardrail systems across 120 scenarios, and the bypasses transferred to 29 unseen guardrails, including commercial ones.

items.title: Threat Spotlight: Email attacks target both humans and AI in the same message
items.summary: Barracuda describes phishing emails that pair a social-engineering lure for the human with hidden prompt injection aimed at AI assistants that summarize or triage mail. It recommends layered defenses such as input sanitization and human approval for sensitive actions.

items.title: Jailbreaking Your PS4 in 2026: The New WebKitty Guide for Firmware 13.52 (No Disc Needed)
items.summary: Recaps the PS4 scene's timeline: the WebKitty WebKit exploit host went public on September 19, 2026 for firmware up to 13.52, and GoldHEN support followed a day later. The article says firmware 14.00, released September 16, closes the kernel flaw the chain relies on.

items.title: A New PS5 Jailbreak May Have Just Opened The Floodgates To Piracy
items.summary: Reports on Relapse, a new PS5 jailbreak said to work on every firmware version except 14.00.00, which launched in mid-September. The article also covers the piracy concerns it raises.

items.title: PS4 firmware 13.52 jailbreak: reported release and support limits
items.summary: Covers the newly public WebKit route for PS4 firmware 13.02, 13.04, 13.50 and 13.52. At launch it centered on standard HEN, and full GoldHEN support was still pending.

items.title: PS4 Update 14.00 Released on September 16 Brings More of What You Expect
items.summary: Sony released PS4 system update 14.00 on the same day as a large PS5 update, describing it only as performance and stability improvements. MP1st expects it mainly carries security fixes.

items.title: Root из ничего. Исследователь показал универсальный взлом флагманов Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo и OnePlus
items.summary: Researcher Lukas Maar demonstrated 'OEMpocalypse Now', a two-stage chain that takes an unprivileged app to root on locked-bootloader Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo and OnePlus flagships by targeting vendor-added components. Samsung's September 2026 bulletin fixes two related DualDAR flaws, but patch status for the other vendors is unconfirmed.

items.title: iOS 26 Gets First Jailbreak Thanks to Dopamine
items.summary: Dopamine 3.0 from opa334 is the first public jailbreak for iOS 26, about 326 days after the OS launched. It supports only iOS 26.0-26.0.1 on A12 and A13 devices.

items.title: AI Jailbreak Disclosure Is Broken. Here's How to Fix It
items.summary: Rich Barton-Cooper and Adam Gleave argue that researchers who find jailbreaks in frontier models lack safe, consistent ways to report them. They propose public reporting channels, published severity rubrics, and a third-party coordinated-disclosure clearinghouse.

items.title: BreakFun: Jailbreaking LLMs via Object Instantiation under Simulated Code Execution
items.summary: A November 2026 Findings paper describing a jailbreak class that hides harmful requests inside simulated code-execution tasks, reporting high attack success across 13 models on JailbreakBench. The authors also propose a defensive 'prompt deconstruction' check that improves detection.

items.title: PS4 14.02 WebKit Jailbreak Achieved
items.summary: Reports that researcher SaudiDos posted a video showing a WebKit-based HEN running on PS4 firmware 14.02 shortly after Sony released it. The exploit is unreleased, and the report suggests a public release looks unlikely.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News : New Jailbreak On 14.02 Using A Webkit Exploit
items.summary: News video on a private demonstration of a WebKit-based jailbreak running on PS4 firmware 14.02, the newest PS4 firmware.

items.title: The PS4 Jailbreak Situation in 2026: Everything You Need to Know
items.summary: Status overview of PS4 jailbreaking in late 2026: firmware up to 14.00 is reported as exploitable, while 14.02 exists only as a private demo.

items.title: The PS4 Just Got Its Biggest Jailbreak in Years
items.summary: Covers the public jailbreak release for PS4 firmware 13.52, which opened homebrew to a large new range of consoles.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.00 JB teaser, Kstuff 13.60 & FPKG support, GoldHEN 13.52, Homebrew & More
items.summary: News roundup covering a 14.00 jailbreak teaser, the GoldHEN release for PS4 13.52, and PS5 13.60 Kstuff updates.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak Update: 14.00 Patch Released, theflow quits the scene & 13.60 Jailbreak Preview.
items.summary: Reports on Sony's 14.00 firmware patch, researcher theflow leaving the scene, and an early preview of the PS5 13.60 jailbreak.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News Update: BD-J Sandbox Escape Confirmed on 13.50 and below
items.summary: News update on a confirmed Blu-ray Java (BD-J) sandbox escape affecting PS4 firmware 13.50 and earlier.

items.title: PS5 14.10 Jailbreak BREAKTHROUGH! New Prolapse Exploit Explained
items.summary: Explains the announced Prolapse kernel exploit for PS5 firmware 14.00/14.10. Its developer later said it does not work on PS5.

items.title: PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.10 Update, HV bug lives, Y2JB Relapse, Proton, Homebrew, Emulators & More!
items.summary: PS5 news roundup covering Sony's 14.10 system update, a hypervisor bug still present, and Relapse support arriving in the Y2JB loader.

items.title: Dopamine 3.0 IS OUT! | iOS 26.0.1 & Older Jailbreak | Installation Guide + Important Notes
items.summary: Announces the release of Dopamine 3.0, the first public iOS 26 jailbreak (iOS 26.0-26.0.1), and explains its device and version limits.
